scope: Existing artifacts only; CPU statistics; no inference, training, downloads, or writes in face-age.

aligned_phash_cross_split.interpretation: Candidate near-duplicate photographs only; visually review before declaring leakage. This does not identify distinct images of the same person.

raw_dhash_cross_split.interpretation: Candidate near-duplicate photographs only; visually review before declaring leakage. This does not identify distinct images of the same person.

paired_color_audit.method: Fixed bilateral cheek ROI medians in OpenCV float CIELAB (L in 0..100; a/b signed). Delta = generated - same input. Not a segmentation, medical skin measure, ethnic label, or perceptual quality score. All old eval outputs are 256px; native1024 needs separate evaluation.

limitations: The frozen eval photos have already been used in historical model selection; this is a regression set, NOT a fresh blind test set.
There are no subject identity labels. Different photos of one person can still occur on both sides.
Pseudo-age bins are classifier estimates, not known chronological ages.
Capped resampling repeats existing samples and does not add missing older adults or children.
Low-resolution source photos are excluded, not restored by resizing or super-resolution.

aged_aggregate.caution: Exploratory photo-level interval on 24 previously used regression inputs; identity independence is unverified and different photos may show the same person. Not an independent population guarantee.

bounded_training_100.conclusion: Positive exploratory color-consistency signal; retain candidate checkpoints, do not deploy from this 24-photo regression check. Shared ID and age metrics are not independent quality validation.
